metadata.verification_definition: Verified means the event or targeted casting brief and its published access route were checked against primary organizer/venue/provider evidence. It does not confirm live seats, a successful application or a personal meeting.
metadata.date_policy: Exact unknown dates remain null. event_month is a source-published month, not a shooting day. Recurrence-derived next dates are flagged in date_notes.
metadata.price_policy: Numbers are advertised standard entry prices in the stated currency unless price_notes says from-price. Null is unknown, not free. Compensation is separate from price.
